case zbuf8
func zbuf8
set ram:30800/8 0x7012c00050064
set ram:30808/8 0x3200320001ffff
set ram:30820/8 0x9012c00060063
set ram:30828/8 0x31003300008000
set ram:30840/8 0x4444333322221111
set ram:30848/8 0x8888777766665555
set ram:30860/8 0xa003a002a001a000
set ram:30868/8 0xa007a006a005a004
set r16 0x30800
set r17 0x30820
set r18 0x30840
set r19 0x30860
expect ram:30800/8 0x7012c00050063
expect ram:30808/8 0x31003200008000
expect ram:30840/8 0x4444a0022222a000
expect ram:30848/8 0xa0077777a005a004
expect PS 0x1
end
